contacts.name: Rahul Mehta
contacts.notes: Evaluating CRM for a 50-person sales team in Pune.

messages.body:
Hi Alex,

We are moving our 50-member sales team off spreadsheets and would like a quote for 50 licenses of Acme CRM, including onboarding and training. Ideally we want to go live before Diwali. Could you share pricing for an annual plan?

Regards,
Rahul Mehta
FinEdge Loans

Hi Rahul,

Thank you for your interest in Acme CRM. Please find attached our quote for 50 Professional licenses on an annual plan: INR 1,450 per user per month (INR 8.7 lakh per year), with onboarding and two training sessions included at no extra cost. We can have your team live within 10 working days of sign-off, well ahead of Diwali. The quote is valid until 15 October.

Best regards,
Alex
Acme Solutions
